findings.text: The fragment cites /home/ITER/mcintos/.cache/nova-s33/hot-path-written-down/section-check.log as the log for the head claim 'the check reports ... differences 0'. That file is the pre-guard run at revision 4453b6f67 and its ROUTES line carries no map_current field; the head run at bbcc26df6 (map_current true) and the stale-map control run (differences 17) exist only under the crew run directory, and the stale-map paragraph at :75-79 cites no log path at all. The claim is true -- I reproduced it -- but the cited artifact cannot show it, and a crew run directory is transient, so the guard's evidence has no durable citation.

code_changed_since diffs the map's revision against HEAD rather than against the working tree, while the module docstring at :21 and the section prose state it compares with 'the checked tree'. A .py change under nova/ or tests/ left uncommitted in the checkout the check runs in is therefore invisible: the check prints map_current true and exits 0 while the route may already have moved, which is the exact drift this commit exists to catch.
